identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a top 1% Free Fire tournament platform that breaks generic 'gamer' tropes with high-fashion/tactical aesthetics.

project_context.target_audience: Gen Z Gamers, Competitive Guilds, Tournament Organizers
project_context.tech_stack: React (JS), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Framer Motion

usage_rules.hero_text: text-6xl md:text-8xl font-black italic uppercase leading-[0.85]

rules.neon_glows: Use box-shadow for neon effects, not just color.

dashboard.container_style: HUD Interface, Glassmorphism panels, sharp borders

cards.classes: relative bg-card/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 overflow-hidden hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors duration-300
cards.decoration: Add a 45deg cut on the top-right corner using clip-path or pseudo-element.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-widest hover:bg-primary/90 skew-x-[-10deg] px-8 py-6 rounded-none
buttons.secondary: border border-primary text-primary font-bold uppercase tracking-widest hover:bg-primary/10 skew-x-[-10deg] px-8 py-6 rounded-none

inputs.classes: bg-black/50 border-white/20 focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 rounded-none h-12 font-rajdhani

visual_enhancers.textures: Use a subtle 'noise' overlay on the main background (opacity 0.03).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders with 10% opacity white. Active elements get 100% opacity primary color border.
visual_enhancers.decorations: Use 'crosshair' icons (+) in corners of cards for tactical feel.

hero_bg.usage: Hero section background with heavy dark overlay

motion_guidelines.hover: Scale 1.02 + Border Color Change + Glow Increase.
motion_guidelines.scroll: Parallax on background images. Reveal animations for sections.

accessibility_rules.contrast: Ensure text is #E0E0E0 or lighter on dark backgrounds.
accessibility_rules.focus_states: Visible ring-2 ring-primary on all interactive elements.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use gradients for text unless it's a massive headline.
DO NOT use generic 'Inter' font. Use Chakra Petch/Rajdhani.
DO NOT center everything. Use asymmetry.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds. Use bg-black/80 with backdrop-blur.
ALWAYS add data-testid to interactive elements.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Dark mode is mandatory. No light mode toggle.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-energy esports platform. Start by setting up the font imports in index.css. Then, customize the tailwind.config.js with the colors and fonts provided. Build the layout using the 'Tetris' grid for the landing page and 'High Density' grid for the dashboard. Use the provided image URLs. Focus on the 'Tactical' aesthetic—sharp edges, neon accents, and dark backgrounds.
